correctness.rationale: The explicit parity-lift 32-word construction has only two unbordered binary support patterns 00011 and 00101; changing the pattern flips two coordinates, while a single within-pattern change forces the parity fifth-symbol change, so pairwise Hamming distance>=2. Normalize the first-letter set A and disjoint last-letter set B by relabeling/reversal to |A|=1,2. For both, the complete self-unbordered conflict-graph vertex sets of sizes 180 and 240 are certified by 32 cliques each; every pair within each clique conflicts by a proper overlap or Hamming distance<=1, and all vertices are covered. Fresh independent direct audit of the bundled exact certificate verified all 180/240 vertex identities, the clique pair conflicts and full coverage, plus 32 lower words and all 496 unordered pairs. Thus an independent set has <=32 vertices universally, not merely from solver status. Single-template bound min(l^4,l^3(4-l))<=27 with equality by mod-3 checksum.
